requirement: The WordPress planner keeps a link only where the site goes and the plugin takes it

oracle.ref: PR #893 (fix); fix evidence: 05/10/2026, local stand, develop b21c158bc: Apply on ja-kinetic (WordPress) failed with 'Unsupported link: home-signal.cta.chip.url' and wrote nothing. Two real-model plans of that template wrote 1-3 links the plugin refuses and 15-18 links to pages the template does not have, per plan.
oracle.invariant: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# pass' equal to '# tests' (at least 15). Both named cases are 'ok': a bare '#', a plain-http link and a site path the template has no page or link for are pending ('unsupported-url' / 'unknown-page'); a tel: loses its spaces; a path with a query is kept only when the template links there exactly; the template's own link said back is 'unchanged'.
